question: Where is the nearest university as you go northwest from Washington Park Botanical Garden, Springfield, IL?
sql: WITH botanical_garden AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Washington Park Botanical Garden%' AND ST_Intersects( geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Springfield%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1) ) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT pois.poi_name FROM pois, botanical_garden AS bg WHERE pois.amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, bg.geometry::geography, 1000000 -- Search within 1000 km radius for efficiency ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(bg.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 -- Northwest direction (292.5 to 337.5 degrees) ORDER BY ST_Distance(pois.geometry::geography, bg.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
